metadata.title: Bangladesh ADM3 synthetic demo dataset
metadata.coverage_note: Synthetic sample features are generated for all 544 ADM3 units in the bundled 2020 geoBoundaries source, covering all 64 districts. ADM3 includes subdistrict and metropolitan thana units. Coordinates are representative points, not parcel locations. Mouza labels and land/road records are synthetic; this is not a complete or official mouza, cadastral, ownership, or road database.
metadata.administrative_boundary_source: geoBoundaries gbOpen BGD ADM3 and ADM2, boundary year 2020; source data BBS/OCHA ROAP

administrative_boundary_attribution.title: Bangladesh ADM3 representative locations
administrative_boundary_attribution.source: geoBoundaries gbOpen BGD ADM3 and ADM2, boundary year 2020; source data BBS/OCHA ROAP
administrative_boundary_attribution.note: Includes ADM3 subdistricts and metropolitan thana units; representative points are computed from boundary polygons and do not identify mouzas.
